comments.author: @BeyondTheMapTV1
comments.text: Japan’s order becomes more interesting when you realize how much of it depends on everyday social habits rather than simply rules. 🇯🇵🚄 Punctual transport, quiet public spaces and remarkably clean cities require millions of small acts of cooperation. That coexistence of ancient traditions, dense modern cities and strong shared expectations is one of the things that makes daily life there so distinctive.
